title: Marketing with AI
author: Snoo-29395
selftext:
Did you try introducing AI into your marketing pipeline somehow?

I’m not a native speaker so I mostly use it to make better scripts for my videos and to give it 1 or 2 hour worth of footage and create 10-20s clips for shorts/reels.

I’m wondering if I’m underestimating how powerful ai can be for marketing and if there are better ideas on how to use it for it. I’m really willing to hear how you are using to boost reach with low budget, getting wishlists has been really hard.

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body:
From what I've tested myself, it's very useful for generating scripts but you'll still need to tweak them yourself. I also use it a lot for measuring metrics and seeing what needs improvement. It's taken me from my first few shorts getting < 1k views to now I have a pretty solid formula that seems to work consistently.

Each game will be different, just experiment until you find a format that works.

replies.author: Snoo-29395
replies.body: Do you mind sharing how you fixed the stayed to watch %? I’m always around 40-65% and 80% watch time, tried using other games footage first, my own voice, eleven lab voice, no voice and just music, never seems to change significantly the outcome. I’m always stuck between 1-2k

replies.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
replies.body:
Use your own voice, I tried elevenlabs and had no luck as well. 

I would do no music and just your own voice. To fix your stayed to watch you need a better hook, the first 5 seconds are important so make sure you have something exciting going on. For the avg watch time, I recommend adding captions that are slightly different than what you're saying, as that will help keep people engaged. Keep the video moving with as little downtime as possible. 

My latest vid is at 70% stayed to watch and 95% avg watch using just those strats.

replies.author: Snoo-29395
replies.body: Thanks! Will try all that for the next one

comments.author: mentiondesk
comments.body: AI can be super handy beyond content editing and video scripts. For reaching more people, try tracking conversations where folks are actively looking for what you offer and jump into those discussions with value. A tool like ParseStream can help you spot these moments across Reddit and other sites which can really boost your wishlist numbers without a big budget.

replies.author: Snoo-29395
replies.body: Thanks! Will take a look at that tool

comments.author: zayelion
comments.body: Its almost like the writing part of it is stunted on purpose similar to what they did for fable. I have to write it myself and then the AI tunes for tone. If anyone has a story writing pipeline let me know.
